columns.name: Backlog
columns.description: To Do. Branch convention: type/slug (feat|fix|chore|docs|refactor|ci), no ticket ID — set branchName at task creation, never rename later. WARNING: dragging a card here kills the session and removes its worktree.

columns.name: Planning
columns.description: Auto-spawns an opus/xhigh agent in plan mode. On plan approval it auto-advances to Executing (plan approval is the gate here).

columns.name: Executing
columns.description: Auto-spawns an agent that implements the plan and commits on the task branch (no push). Stops on completion; a human drags the card to Code Review.
columns.autoCommand: Implement the approved plan (or, if this card was sent back from Code Review, the requested changes) exactly as scoped — no scope creep, no extra files. When the change is complete and the working tree is clean, commit it ON THIS BRANCH: git add -A && git commit -m "<type>: <summary>" using the Conventional-Commit <type> that matches the branch prefix ({{branchName}}). Do NOT push, open a PR, rename the branch, or move the card. Post a short summary of what you changed and STOP — a human reviews the commit and drags the card to Code Review.

columns.name: Code Review
columns.description: On entry, kills the executing session and spawns a fresh, independent reviewer that runs /code-review high on git diff main...HEAD and reports findings. Does NOT fix or push. Manual gate: a human sends it back to Executing (request changes) or drags it to Open PR. Never drag back to Backlog (that removes the worktree).

columns.name: Open PR
columns.description: On entry, kills the session and spawns a release agent that pushes the branch, opens a PR (gh pr create --base main), and links it via kangentic_link_pr. Does NOT merge. A human merges, then drags the card to Done.

columns.name: Done
columns.description: Merged / complete. Moving a card here kills its session.
